title: 第十七章 带着前任找下任
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
内室静谧无声，两人相对而坐，气氛显得有些古怪。

    萧姚双眼微阖，把全部精力都凝聚在虚虚贴着苍岚丹田的右手上。

    苍岚睁大眼睛，一眨不眨，用视线描摹萧姚的五官，仿佛要把她的音容笑貌尽数刻进脑海深处。

    苍岚的目光太过专注，萧姚想装无知无觉都做不到。

    她轻轻叹了口气，抬眼对上苍岚执着的目光，低声问：

    “怎么了？”

    苍岚缓缓眨动干涩的眼睛，执拗地盯着她看：

    “姐姐，让苍岚再多看几眼吧……”

    “苍岚想记住姐姐的模样。”

    萧姚闻言，一言不发地收了势，暗自调息一会儿，语气淡淡地下了逐客令：

    “小狼，你的妖力已经平稳，如今夜深了，你该去休息了。”

    苍岚乖乖起身，然后站在她身旁一动不动。

    萧姚没理他，自顾自地进了寝屋，关上了门。

    苍岚抬腿想跟，又强压下冲动，委屈巴巴地蹲在门口，两只耳朵贴着头皮，可怜地趴着。

    一扇门，将两人隔开，咫尺天涯。

    025终于忍不住冒出头，弱弱开口：

    【宿主……苍岚在外边蹲着呢，看着怪可怜的……反正就最后一晚上，要不你就圆他个梦？】

    萧姚逼着自己硬下心肠。

    【菜统，我再妥协下去一直给他希望，那才是不负责任。】

    当断不断必受其乱。

    先撩者贱，她认了她补偿，但她不是原主，做不来吊着人养鱼的事。

    ……

    苍岚在门外，从天黑守到天亮，终于用一个晚上的时间确定，这个狠心的女人，打算撩完就跑！

    哪怕他示弱卖惨，哪怕她好像动了恻隐之心，也没有半点负责到底的念头！

    也是，一个风流纨绔，能指望她有几分真心。

    苍岚讽刺地笑了笑，戴上宽沿帽子遮住狼耳，悄无声息地离开了洞府。

    他挑了一条隐蔽的小路，缩着肩膀，灰溜溜地回了自己的小木屋，关上门，取出床底下装着萧姚赠礼的箱子，安静地等鱼上钩。

    他回来的路上，隐约嗅到不少仇家的气息，他的表演绝对能让他们相信，他被萧姚放弃赶了出来。

    这个时候不来落井下石，不可能的……

    果然，不出多时，小木屋的门被人踹开。

    苍岚瑟缩着捂紧帽子，色厉内荏地恐吓道：

    “姐姐她马上就来，你们……你们别太过分！”

    曹金戈猖狂大笑：
content_en:
The inner room was silent, the two people sat opposite each other, and the atmosphere seemed a bit strange.

Xiao Yao closed his eyes slightly and concentrated all his energy on Xuxu's right hand which was pressed against Cang Lan's dantian.

Cang Lan opened her eyes wide and without blinking, traced Xiao Yao's facial features with her eyes, as if she wanted to carve all of her voice, face, and smile into the depths of her mind.

Cang Lan's eyes were so focused that Xiao Yao couldn't even pretend to be ignorant.

She sighed softly, raised her eyes to meet Cang Lan's persistent gaze, and asked in a low voice:

"What's wrong?"

Cang Lan slowly blinked her dry eyes and stared at her stubbornly:

"Sister, let Cang Lan look at her a few more times..."

"Cang Lan wants to remember her sister's appearance."

Hearing this, Xiao Yao stopped his position without saying a word, adjusted his breath secretly for a while, and issued an order to expel guests in a calm tone:

"Xiaolang, your demon power has stabilized. It's late at night now, it's time for you to rest."

Cang Lan stood up obediently, then stood motionless beside her.

Xiao Yao ignored him, went into the bedroom and closed the door.

Cang Lan raised her legs to follow, but suppressed the impulse and squatted at the door aggrievedly, with her ears pressed to her scalp, lying on her stomach pitifully.

A door separates the two people, so close to each other.

025 finally couldn't help but raised his head and spoke weakly:

[Host... Cang Lan is squatting outside, looking very pitiful... It's just the last night anyway, how about you make his dream come true?】

Xiao Yao forced himself to harden his heart.

[Cai Tong, if I continue to compromise and keep giving him hope, that would be irresponsible.】

If you continue to cut off, you will be subject to chaos.

The one who flirted first was a bitch, so she recognized her as compensation, but she was not the original owner, so she couldn't do anything like raising fish while holding someone else hostage.

…

Cang Lan stayed outside the door, guarding her from dusk to dawn, and finally spent one night determining that this cruel woman planned to run away after flirting with her!

Even if he showed weakness and acted miserably, even if she seemed to feel compassion, she had no idea of ​​taking responsibility to the end!

Also, for a romantic dandy, you can expect her to be somewhat sincere.

Cang Lan smiled sarcastically, put on a wide-brimmed hat to cover her wolf ears, and left the cave quietly.

He chose a hidden path, hunched his shoulders, and returned to his cabin dejectedly. He closed the door, took out the box containing Xiao Yao's gift from under the bed, and quietly waited for the fish to take the bait.

On his way back, he vaguely smelled the scent of many enemies. His performance could definitely convince them that he was kicked out by Xiao Yao.

It's impossible not to add insult to injury at this time...

Sure enough, not long after, the door of the cabin was kicked open.

Cang Lan shrank and clutched her hat tightly, and threatened in a stern voice:

"Sister, she will be here soon. You...don't go too far!"

Cao Jinge laughed wildly:
title_en: Chapter 17: Bring your ex with you to find your next one
